title: "'Trapeze' antiradar attachments to the U-2" – planform wiring schematic (p. 129)
description: Line drawing of a U-2 seen from above, showing antiradar wires strung from the nose to the wings and along the wingspan and tail. Labels point to "Chordwise wire," "Spanwise wire," "Ferrite beads" and "Fiberglass member." Captioned "'Trapeze' antiradar attachments to the U-2"; the text describes Project RAINBOW radar-deception work by the Scientific Engineering Institute.
